articles.title: Olympic Swimmer vs. Giant Fish: Who's Stronger?
articles.summary: Caeleb Dressel, a 9-time Olympic champ, tried pulling fishing lines like big fish. He beat tuna-level drag but struggled against marlin and grouper power. Watch him battle the ocean's toughest!

articles.title: Earth: The Coolest Planet (You're Already On It!)
articles.summary: Earth is the only planet with life, thanks to its perfect mix of air, water, and land. It's just the right distance from the sun, and it's full of mysteries—even more than the moon!

articles.title: PlayStation Fans Are Angry: What's Going On?
articles.summary: PlayStation announced they'll stop making game discs, and fans are upset. They're showing their anger online with messages like 'NO DISC NO BUY.' Sony isn't responding, which makes fans even more frustrated.
